03889 Luwsh {loosh}

源自 03888; 專有名詞 人名

AV - Laish 1; 1

拉億 = "獅子"
1) 帕鐵的父親, 掃羅王將其女兒米甲許配給帕鐵為妻, 雖然那時米甲已經先嫁給了大衛 (#撒下 3:15|)
record.edic_text:
03889 Luwsh {loosh}

from 03888;; n pr loc

AV - Laish 1; 1

Laish = "lion"
1) father of Phaltiel, the man to whom king Saul gave his daughter
   Michal in marriage even though she was already married to David
